mix_target.principle: Field realism first. Dialogue must remain intelligible; avoid trailer-style over-scoring.
mix_target.loudness_note: Keep one-shot field SFX below dialogue and UI confirmation cues. Final mastering is deferred until real recordings exist.
mix_target.mobile_note: Prefer compact mono for radio/office detail and stereo only where space materially improves immersion.

format_target.delivery_rule: Do not add an asset to the runtime manifest until the real binary exists and has been reviewed.

assets.direction: Early-morning construction gate: idling diesel vehicles, distant reverse alarm, tire/road texture, no intelligible speech.
reject: clearly identifiable real company radio call

assets.direction: Short construction-radio squelch, clipped push-to-talk texture and faint unintelligible voice tail.
Foundation workface tension: metal contact, footsteps on temporary path, distant machinery and compressed work rhythm.
Concrete pump truck entering, low diesel idle rising slightly, hydraulic boom movement beginning, exterior construction acoustics.
Wet concrete through hose with pump pulse, hose movement, rebar/workface texture; energetic but not deafening.
A short machinery tail/cut followed by sparse room/workface tone; the dramatic effect should come from reduced activity, not a loud hit.
Site office room tone: HVAC/computer hum, distant site machinery through wall, light paper/keyboard texture.
Quiet Korean apartment-like night room tone without identifiable TV/music; far traffic optional.

integration.current: Each of the 26 Episode 01 immersive events resolves to one of eight production audio asset slots. If absent, the reviewed production binary is replaced by a lightweight field-oriented WebAudio cue (clean/radio/pressure/air timbre families).
integration.finalization: When a reviewed binary is added under public/assets/episode01/audio and registered in assets.json generation, no story or event rule changes are required.
qa_surfaces: reduced motion has no audio coupling

synthetic_fallback.principle: Fallback cues suggest field texture without competing with dialogue or pretending to be final recordings.
